sources.commercialRestriction: none; retain the source license and attribution
sources.limitations: Not a normal-entire-body diagnosis, not a confirmed stone/trauma patient. Native reconstruction uses soft-tissue kernel; changing display window does not create a sharp bone reconstruction. Do not use automated segmentation as gold-standard anatomy. AuthorREADME saysCC-BY4.0 while Zenodo metadata and publication sayCC0. Both permit adaptation and redistribution including commercial use; preserve attribution and record both, do not label ambiguously sourced data as exclusivelyCC0. Source has a cardiac pacemaker. The selected lung sequence uses LPS slices 777-846, away from the generator and pronounced lead streaks; it is not an implant-free or fully normal examination. Reviewed coverage includes kidneys, lumbar spine and upper pelvis.
sources.protocolEvidence: Adult ECG-gated non-contrast CT, curated normal-aorta category; chest/abdomen field of view. Selected anatomical range must be inspected before mapping.

sources.limitations: 80-year-old female right cadaveric wrist, not a living fracture case. Specimen preparation has soft-tissue gas. Use as brief bone anatomy presentation only, never fracture evidence. Anonymized DICOM age 001D is not the real age. Native 0.1 mm step decimated to 2 mm sampled interval.
